titulo_en: It is clear that you are tired

whatever.es: cualquier cosa que; lo que sea

evidence.es: prueba; indicios o información que apoyan una idea

consejo.@es: Forma de «seem» con he, she, it.

appear.es: aparecer; parecer (en sentido de dar la impresión)

texto.@es: **It is clear that…** (está claro que…). **I suspect that…** (sospecho que…). **I don't know whether…** (no sé si…). **Whether** introduce una pregunta indirecta de sí/no o una alternativa: **I don't know whether he will come or not**. En muchas preguntas indirectas se puede usar **if**; usa **whether**, no **if**, antes de **to + verbo** y después de una preposición: **We talked about whether to go** (hablamos de si ir).
texto.@en: **It is clear that…** (it is clear that). **I suspect that…** (I suspect that). **I don't know whether…** (I don't know if). **Whether** introduces an indirect yes / no question or an alternative: **I don't know whether he will come or not**. In many indirect questions you can use **if**; use **whether**, not **if**, before **to + verbo** and after a preposition: **We talked about whether to go** (we talk about whether to go).

texto.@es: **Whatever you say is fine with me** (cualquier cosa que digas me parece bien): la cláusula con **whatever** funciona como sujeto. En cambio, **Whatever you say, I won't agree** significa «digas lo que digas» y es una concesiva, no una subordinada sustantiva. **It's a pity that…** (es una lástima que…): **that…** completa la expresión **a pity**.
texto.@en: **Whatever you say is fine with me** (anything you say seems right to me): the **whatever** clause works as a subject. In contrast, **Whatever you say, I won't agree** means «Whatever you say» and is a concessionaire, not a substantive subordinate. **It's a pity that…** (it's a pity that): **that…** completes the **a pity** expression.

texto.@es: **Seem** y **appear** pueden expresar que algo parece de cierta manera; **appear** también puede significar «aparecer».
texto.@en: **Seem** and **appear** can express that something seems in a certain way; **appear** can also mean «aparecer».

explicacion.@es: Whether = si, en una duda.
explicacion.@en: Whether = yes, in a doubt.

explicacion.@es: **It is clear that** = «está claro que»; **you** no especifica género.
explicacion.@en: **It is clear that** = «It is clear that»; **you** does not specify gender.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería when.
explicacion.@en: That would be when.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería but.
explicacion.@en: That would be but.

bloques.frase: I suspect ___ the rumour is old.

explicacion.@es: I suspect that = sospecho que.
explicacion.@en: I suspect that = I suspect that.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería lo que.
explicacion.@en: That would be what.

explicacion.@es: Aquí se completa **I suspect that...**; **whether** introduce una pregunta indirecta.
explicacion.@en: Here you complete **I suspect that...**; **whether** introduces an indirect question.

explicacion.@es: Antes de **to + verbo**, se usa **whether**, no **if**.
explicacion.@en: Before **to + verbo**, **whether**, not **if**, is used.

explicacion.@es: En esta estructura no se usa **if + to + verbo**.
explicacion.@en: **if + to + verbo** is not used in this structure.

explicacion.@es: **That** introduce una afirmación, no esta alternativa.
explicacion.@en: **That** introduces an affirmation, not this alternative.

bloques.frase: ___ you say is fine with me.

explicacion.@es: La cláusula **Whatever you say** es el sujeto.
explicacion.@en: The **Whatever you say** clause is the subject.

explicacion.@es: **What** significa «lo que», pero no expresa aquí «cualquier cosa que».
explicacion.@en: **What** means «which», but does not express «anything that» here.

explicacion.@es: Se refiere a cualquier persona, no a cualquier cosa que digas.
explicacion.@en: It means anyone, not anything you say.
